definition.boundary_edge: S\{x}->S with |S|=k and x the final label
definition.pair_scope: all unordered pairs of distinct C88 targets incomparable in the C88 subgroup poset
definition.race_formula: left_first edges are left pivots with right not hit on S; right_first symmetrically; tie edges are simultaneous pivots
definition.random_object: uniform permutation of the sixteen C75 named labels
definition.target_times: T_i=min{k:H_i<=Phi(A_k)} from the frozen C88 hit bitsets
definition.time_convention: time zero is included as an explicit zero cell for every incomparable pair
